name: body
description: The full prose content of this record, in Markdown.

aiGuidance.purpose: Everything the reader needs that does not fit in summary: the argument, the detail, the worked examples. Markdown so that lists, tables and code blocks survive rendering.
aiGuidance.extraction: Carry over the source prose largely intact rather than paraphrasing it away — this field is where the original reasoning is preserved. Use Markdown headings only from level 2 down; the record's own title supplies level 1. Move any decision or justification into rationale instead of burying it here.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not use body as an overflow for structured data that a field already models — wave, door, decision_mode, issue_ref and evidence each have their own field, and duplicating them in prose defeats querying.
